The shopper's cancellation, allowed while AUTHORIZED (before anything is in transit) and by lazy expiry; publishes `ReturnCancelled` with reason `SHOPPER_REQUESTED`. Cancelling again, or after RECEIVED/CLOSED_KEEP, is `409 illegal-transition`; an authorization that expired untouched answers `422 authorization-expired` (and is cancelled by that very read).
